thesis: A net-cash, high-ROIC Japanese noodle and food maker trading at the low end of its own P/E range and well below peers.
reason: High and stable returns, net cash, buybacks and a P/E near its 5y low give scorecard conviction 4 on a real own-history discount; no trend support is needed. Sized by Python at the conviction-4 core size, vol-scaled. Cash, holdings count and the staples sector have room, so no replacement.

triggers.text: Balance sheet levers up: debt/EBITDA (statistics page) rises above 1x, ending the net cash position
